name: Astro Turf Cricket Pitch Roll
tagline: Practice pitch surface with true bounce and durable turf backing.
shortDescription: Astro turf cricket pitch roll ideal for academies, schools, and training centers.
description: The Astro Turf Cricket Pitch Roll creates a consistent training wicket for bowlers and batters. It is designed for repeated use on concrete or prepared surfaces, offering dependable grip, rebound, and long-term durability for academy practice environments.

specifications.label: Use Case
specifications.value: Portable and fixed cricket practice pitches

name: Artificial Infill Field Grass
tagline: Artificial sports grass for training grounds and multi-use playing surfaces.
shortDescription: Infill-ready artificial field grass for sports flooring and outdoor installations.
description: Artificial Infill Field Grass is built for sports spaces that need resilient, low-maintenance surfaces. It works well for cricket practice zones, football grounds, and multi-sport facilities where durability, drainage, and a professional look are important.

specifications.label: Usage
specifications.value: Sports grounds, turf zones, and training areas
